Independent review of merge f09066772: APPROVE WITH FOLLOW-UPS, fit to gate.
- Fidelity: blob-by-blob, 0 mismatches; no path changed on both sides; S0/S1 files equal d02c58df8; .mote/authority identical to main (956).
- Review provenance (SD2, owner ruling needed): of the line's 97 Codex commits only the queue-review group has a second-actor review; all other groups carry author-written review claims only, about 30 commits are cited by nothing, and the Sherlock Qwen check has no review claim. A cold review of at least the production Scala (11 align, 5 codec, 5 pipeline main files, embed-onnx) is suggested if the owner does not accept the Codex-internal reviews.
- Rule 14d (owner ruling needed): no verbatim story text, transcript or excerpt in 707 paths or the 96 committed gz logs; docs/plans/2026-10-21-scoring-correction.md and sherlock-qwen-review-20261020/README.md paraphrase Sherlock frames and dialogue content.
- Sibling seam: BLOCK for landing (not gating): codec and align main code change and storyatlas4s imports both; storyatlas4s must build and test against f09066772.
- Gate: 16 cross-built modules need JVM, JS and Native; 8 JVM-only; build.sbt changed, so githubWorkflowGenerate. No secrets, binaries or build output.
